'''Kiraya Tatara''' and her [[Gender|sister]] [[Thakira Tatara]] were [[humanoid]]s who worked as spiritual [[Horticulturalist|horticulturists]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Kiraya specialized in medicinal [[plant]]s and traveled with Thakira from the [[Southern Isles]] to [[Olega City]] to [[Merchant|sell]] their wares. In [[132 BBY]], the pair spent [[time]] near [[Olega Apothecary]] in the [[city]] and drank together nearby at [[Local day|night]].

==Biography==
Kiraya Tatara was a [[humanoid]] [[Gender|female]] who worked as a spiritual [[Horticulturalist|horticulturist]] with her sister [[Thakira Tatara]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. The pair traveled from the [[Southern Isles]] to the island [[capital]] [[Olega City]] in order to sell exotic [[seed]]s and [[Plant|sprigs]] as [[Merchant|street vendors]] in the [[city]]'s markets. Kiraya focused on medicinal growing in her [[Kiraya Tatara's greenhouse|greenhouse]] and supplied [[balm]]s and [[oil]]s to local apothecaries and healing houses. Thakira instead concentrated on nutritive plants.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

[[File:TataraSisters-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=In a busy Olega City street, Mae-ho Aniseya works purposefully toward the viewer while Kiraya Tatara and Thakira Tatara walk in the opposite direction, their long ginger hair clearly visible.|Kiraya Tatara and Thakira Tatara sold goods in Olega City.]]
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> the sisters walked together through the streets of Olega City past the [[Olega Apothecary]] as the [[Sith assassin]] entered the building to [[Mae's quest|meet]] with her ally [[The Stranger|Qimir]]. When Qimir later returned to the building, the two sisters were stood outside at a stall with several other customers. Later that [[Local day|night]], Kiraya and Thakira sat together under an awning near the apothecary drinking from bottles<ref name="RevengeJustice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref> as other merchants packed up their stalls for the night<ref name="RevengeJusticeAD">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> in the streets around them.<ref name="RevengeJustice" />

==Personality and traits==
Kiraya had light skin and [[Color|ginger]] [[hair]] with a band of green around her [[eye]]s.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Equipment==
She and her sister wore matching [[Clothing|outfits]] including a blue dress, a black-patterned brown shirt, a green [[jacket]], and a matching green hood. They both carried brown seed satchels that had been handloomed.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kiraya Tatara appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
